legal: This statement is prepared for the named account holder and reports holdings, movements and performance for the period shown. It is not a contract note, not a tax statement, and not a solicitation to buy or sell.

Valuations are struck at the last published net asset value of the period. Between valuation points the value of your holdings will move, and the figures shown may differ from the value realised on a subsequent redemption.

Performance is shown net of fees actually charged to this account and is specific to your subscription and redemption dates. It will therefore differ from the strategy level performance published in the monthly fact sheet.

Investments in digital assets and decentralized finance strategies involve significant risks, including the potential loss of capital. Risks include market risk, liquidity risk, valuation risk, operational and technology risks, regulatory risk, and smart contract risk.
Please review this statement and report any discrepancy within XX days. In the absence of notice within that period the statement will be treated as accepted.
positions_note: Valued at the last published NAV of the period. Weights may not sum to 100% due to rounding.
movements_note: Movements settle at the NAV struck on the dealing date, which may differ from the instruction date.
